why: Electronics shops sell phones and accessories with IMEI tracking, warranty dates and service/repair intake. Each phone is a serialised unit with its own warranty claim.
operator: The electronics shop owner manages a serialised inventory of phones and accessories, warranty claims and repair jobs. Their day is receiving new stock, tracking warranty expiry and handling repair quotes.
entities: Shop (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
PhoneUnit (id, shopId, imei, model, colour, storage, warrantyStart, warrantyEnd, costPiasters, pricePiasters, status, locationShelf, faultNote)
Accessory (id, shopId, name, type, pricePiasters, costPiasters, stockQty, status, locationShelf)
RepairJob (id, phoneId, customerName, customerPhone, complaint, quotePiasters, approvedBy, status, completedAt, notes)
WarrantyClaim (id, phoneId, customerName, customerPhone, issue, status, claimedAt, resolvedAt, authorisedBy)
Supplier (id, nameAr, phone, paymentTerms, visitDays, leadTimeDays)
PurchaseOrder (id, supplierId, status, lines, expectedAt, totalPiasters)
Staff (id, shopId, name, phone, role, hourlyRatePiasters, status)
batches: No : electronics shop carries no stock or expiry (IMEI is serial number not batch)
expiry: Warranty has start and end dates, not product expiry
special: The core structures are the IMEI-tracked phone unit, the repair job with quote and status, and the warranty claim lifecycle. IMEI is equipment data not personal data but receipts carry buyer phone if captured.
screens: Phone catalogue: grid of phone units with IMEI, model, colour, storage, price, warranty status, fault note
Phone detail: full unit info, warranty dates, fault note, history of repairs
Accessory catalogue: grid of accessories with name, type, price, stock
Repair job creation: enter phone IMEI, complaint, generate quote, set status (draft/approved/in-progress/completed)
Warranty claim creation: enter phone IMEI, customer details, issue, set status (open/pending/resolved)
Repair status tracker: per job, view progress, mark completed, print completion receipt
Warranty claim tracker: per unit, view status, resolution, update status
Cash register: scan IMEI or SKU, apply discount, tender payment, print receipt with IMEI
Staff shift: clock in/out, customer load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : inventory, repairs, warranties, reports, billing
Sales rep: manage phone stock, create repair jobs, handle warranty claims
Technician: view repair jobs, mark in-progress/completed, update warranty claims
Cashier: scan IMEI/SKU, tender payment, print receipt
reports: Phone inventory by model and storage: count per model/colour/storage, turnover rate
Repair job pipeline: draft/approved/in-progress/completed counts, average duration
Warranty claim rate: open/pending/resolved counts, resolution time, common issues
Phone sales by model and period: volume and revenue per model per month
Accessory sales by type and period: volume and revenue per accessory type per month
integrations: Web API for IMEI validation (optional, carrier lookup)
Esc/POS thermal printer for receipts and repair completion notes
WhatsApp deep link for customer repair status updates and warranty notifications
onboarding: Shop basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Initial inventory: the starting phone list with IMEI, model, colour, storage, price and warranty dates
Repair types: the repair categories (screen replacement, battery, charging port, water damage, others)
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: receive first phone stock, create first repair job, first warranty claim
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the IMEI-tracked phone unit and role templates.

tasks.title: Add IMEI-tracked phone catalogue
tasks.brief: Build the phone catalogue: grid of phone units with IMEI, model, colour, storage, price, warranty status, fault note. Done when the catalogue loads and displays units with IMEI badges correctly.
tasks.done: When phone catalogue displays live data with IMEI tracking

tasks.title: Add repair job creation and status tracker
tasks.brief: Build the repair job screen: enter phone IMEI, complaint, generate quote, set status (draft/approved/in-progress/completed). Done when the job is saved and status updates propagate.
tasks.done: When repair job creation works end-to-end with status tracking

tasks.title: Add warranty claim creation and tracker
tasks.brief: Build the warranty claim screen: enter phone IMEI, customer details, issue, set status (open/pending/resolved). Done when the claim is saved and status updates propagate.
tasks.done: When warranty claim creation works end-to-end with status tracking

tasks.title: Add repair status tracker per job
tasks.brief: Build the repair tracker: per job view progress, mark completed, print completion receipt. Done when the tracker updates job status and prints receipt correctly.
tasks.done: When repair status tracker works end-to-end and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add warranty claim tracker per unit
tasks.brief: Build the warranty tracker: per unit view status, resolution, update status. Done when the tracker updates claim status and displays correct state.
tasks.done: When warranty claim tracker works end-to-end and displays correct state

tasks.title: Add cash register with IMEI/SKU scanning
tasks.brief: Build the cash register: scan IMEI or SKU, apply discount, tender payment, print receipt with IMEI. Done when the sale records IMEI and receipt prints correctly.
tasks.done: When cash register works end-to-end with IMEI scanning and receipt prints

tasks.title: Add phone inventory by model report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing count per model/colour/storage and turnover rate. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When phone inventory report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add repair pipeline report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing repair jobs by status (draft/approved/in-progress/completed) and average duration. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When repair pipeline report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add warranty claim rate report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing warranty claims by status (open/pending/resolved) and resolution time. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When warranty claim rate report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial electronics shop setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: shop basics, initial phone inventory with IMEI, repair types, staff addition. Done when the flow completes and the shop appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and shop is created

risks: Encryption key loss makes phone unit and warranty records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Warranty claims without clear start/end dates can violate consumer protection law
IMEI data stored without proper consent can raise privacy concerns if receipts expose buyer phone
